rationale: load_and_validate's logger.warning is what all eight other call sites rely on for warning visibility - removing it would silence warnings across ll-loop run, ll-loop edit and others, a behavior change far beyond this bug. cmd_validate's loop is local and purely duplicative. Dropping it also keeps both warning channels on stderr rather than splitting them across stderr and stdout.
rule: cmd_validate's duplicate warning print loop (config_cmds.py:93-94) is removed; load_and_validate's logger.warning emission (structural_rules.py:1769-1770) is the single warning channel.
alternatives_rejected: Removing load_and_validate's logger.warning loop instead - rejected because it silences warnings for every other caller.
